page_title: HEI 0-4 BAY | Heidenheim v Bayern Munich 21/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The match has just finished.
90+2' 0 - 4 Goal! After receiving a sweet pass, Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) unleashes a shot straight into the bottom right corner. Good team effort!
90+1' Vincent Kompany prepares a substitution. Dayot Upamecano is replaced by Cassiano Kiala (Bayern Munich).
90+1' The manager makes a subsitution with Wisdom Mike (Bayern Munich) coming on for Michael Olise.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' The attendance for today's match is 15000.
90' Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
89' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
86' 0 - 3 Goal! Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) makes the score 0:3 after burying a close-range header in the middle of the goal after a good run and cross by Josip Stanisic.
85' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) wins a header inside the box after a cross and steers it goalwards, but Diant Ramaj produces a wonderful reflex save.
85' A pass by Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
83' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) releases a decent shot towards the middle of the goal from the edge of the box, but it's comfortably gathered by Diant Ramaj.
79' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) places a shot at goal from the edge of the box that bends just wide of the right post.
78' Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim) meets the lofted pass inside the box with a well placed low shot towards the middle of the goal, but Jonas Urbig pulls off a fantastic save to deny him.
77' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
77' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
75' Niklas Dorsch (Heidenheim) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
73' Vincent Kompany decides to make a substitution. Hiroki Ito will be replaced by Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich).
72' We are about to witness a substitution. David Daiber (Bayern Munich) is replacing Raphael Guerreiro.
72' Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim) is adjudged offside.
70' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) commits a rough challenge and Florian Badstubner blows his whistle for a foul.
68' What a big chance! Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and skies the ball well over the bar.
66' Substitution. Marnon Busch makes way for Julian Niehues (Heidenheim).
66' Jan Schoppner will be replaced by Mikkel Kaufmann Sorensen (Heidenheim).
66' Here is a change. Marvin Pieringer is going off and Frank Schmidt gives the last tactical orders to Sirlord Conteh (Heidenheim).
65' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
63' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) will replace Lennart Karl.
59' Hiroki Ito (Bayern Munich) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
57' A pass into the penalty area from Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) is intercepted by the defence.
57' Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
56' Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim) places a close-range header from a rebound onto the crossbar!
55' Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
53' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) gathers the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot. The ball, though, only brushes the left post.
52' Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Diant Ramaj comes off his line to intercept.
51' The Bayern Munich players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
47' Niklas Dorsch (Heidenheim) jumps into a tackle and Florian Badstubner signals a foul.
46' Frank Schmidt has decided to substitute Mathias Honsak and he is replaced by Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim).
46' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Luca Kerber as he is replaced by Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim).
46' Referee Florian Badstubner blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
42' Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
42' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) is desperate to score a goal, but he misses the target after striking the ball well wide of the left post.

38' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) clutches his head in despair after he blew a huge opportunity! He received the ball via the free kick, took a good first touch and unleashed a projectile from close range to the top of the net, but Diant Ramaj makes a nice save.
37' A clumsy foul by Luca Kerber (Heidenheim) and Florian Badstubner blows his whistle.
35' The free kick is delivered by Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
34' Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) commits a rough foul. Florian Badstubner stops the game and makes a call.
34' A cross from Josip Stanisic (Bayern Munich) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
32' 0 - 2 Goal! Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) fires the rebound inside the right post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:2.
28' A pass by Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
27' Josip Stanisic (Bayern Munich) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
24' Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Florian Badstubner no option but to blow his whistle.
22' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) works the corner short.

21' The free kick from Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) failed to provide any scoring opportunity, as one of the defenders did a good job and knocked it out. The ball is out of play. Bayern Munich will have a chance to score from a corner.
19' Luca Kerber (Heidenheim) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
17' The linesman raises his flag. Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) is adjudged offside.
15' 0 - 1 Josip Stanisic (Bayern Munich) gets to a rebound inside the six-yard box and produces a header. He manages to put the ball into the roof of the net, and thus alter the score to 0:1.
14' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) is about to take a corner kick.
13' Bayern Munich take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

13' Jonathan Tah (Bayern Munich) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and attempts to place his header into the middle of the goal. Diant Ramaj shows his fast reflexes, though, and makes a nice save.
12' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
9' The ball is cleared after Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
7' Great teamplay by Bayern Munich as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
4' The resulting corner from Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) is cleared by the defence.

3' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. Bayern Munich have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
2' Josip Stanisic (Bayern Munich) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
1' The first half has just begun.
Bayern Munich will kick-off.
Florian Badstubner is introduced as the referee for today's match.
